data.narrative:
Govini, a Growth-stage defense and security software company founded by Eric Gillespie, has raised $174M to date. The broader Defense & Security sector comprises 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable here, using the $174M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $209M. Peer-median triangulation was not feasible; while 22 same-sector companies exist, none satisfied the stringent filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or comparable valuation tier, falling short of the three-datapoint threshold required for reliable median benchmarking.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $177M to $240M, with a median estimate of $209M. This range reflects a ±15% band around the stage-progression output, appropriate given reliance on a single method. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow peer comparables within Growth-stage Defense & Security, limiting cross-check validation. A stronger triangulation would require either higher-confidence peer comps at similar maturity and AUM, or access to recent transaction multiples in the sector. The current estimate should be treated as preliminary pending additional market data.
